findings.claim: The production-manifest gate can pass when Mermaid or Shiki is bundled into a statically reachable chunk whose manifest key does not name the engine, so it does not deterministically prove that the engines are outside the initial graph.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria 3.4 and 4.2 require deterministic initial-graph assertions, but `forbiddenStatic` only applies `/vendor-(?:mermaid|shiki)|node_modules\/.+(?:mermaid|shiki)/` to reachable manifest keys; the checker never inspects the modules or emitted code inside a generically named reachable chunk.
findings.suggested_fix: Emit or consume build metadata that records each reachable chunk's module IDs and fail when any statically reachable chunk contains a Mermaid or Shiki module; retain the existing facade-name checks as a separate assertion.

findings.claim: A mounted code block can continue to display `Copied` after its source changes even though the newly displayed source has not been copied.
findings.evidence: `copied` is component state, the `[language, source, theme]` effect resets only `highlighted` and `failed`, and no source-change path resets `copied`; only the copy-button promise updates it.
findings.suggested_fix: Reset `copied` to false whenever `source` changes, while preserving the current tokenization cancellation behavior.
